newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Polar adds third weekly Amsterdam-US flight today.
newsitem.headline: Polar adds third weekly Amsterdam-US flight today.

text.p: Polar Air is increasing its weekly Amsterdam freighter flights to New York to three with effect from today, the airline's Dutch gsa Inter Aviation Services director Jacques Heeremans told Reuters.
The U.S. carrier previously operated a twice-weekly, scheduled, freighter service to the U.S. from Amsterdam and London, he said.

Polar Air's Friday and Sunday flights leave from Amsterdam to New York, with connections on to Australia and New Zealand via Los Angeles. The new frequency also has onward connections on to Latin America.
Scheduled road feeder services operate from Amsterdam Schiphol Airport to other destinations in Europe.
New York, Chicago, Atlanta, Auckland New Zealand, Sydney and Melbourne, Miami, Sao Paulo, Asuncion, Buenos Aires, and Santiago de Chile are destinations served by the carrier.

Polar Air has a 12-strong fleet of Boeing 747 freighters although two additional aircraft are expected to join the fleet in 1998, he added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
